Save these prompts and use them to turn simple ideas into digital products. 1️⃣ PROMPT 1: EBOOK CREATOR 📚 Act as a professional digital product creator. Give me 40 original coloring page ideas about \[topic\], along with a compelling cover concept, welcome page, final page, and an SEO-optimized product description designed to attract potential buyers. 4️⃣ PROMPT 4: PRINTABLE PLANNER CREATOR 📅 Create the complete content for a 30-day printable planner focused on \[goal\]. Organize everything so it's ready to design in Canva. 5️⃣ PROMPT 5: DIGITAL RESOURCE BUNDLE 💻 Act as a digital product strategist. Create a complete digital resource bundle for \[ideal customer\]. Include checklists, a quick-start guide, worksheets, a content calendar, editable templates, and additional bonus resources. Write all the content so I can copy it directly into Canva and turn it into a professional digital product bundle. 6️⃣ PROMPT 6: VIRAL DIGITAL PRODUCT IDEAS 💰 Act as an Etsy and digital product expert. Give me 20 digital product ideas that I can create using Canva and sell this month. Rank them from highest to lowest estimated market demand. Include a recommended selling price, ideal customer, and SEO keywords to help each product get discovered. You don't need to be a professional designer or writer to start experimenting with digital products. Here's a simple beginner workflow: 1. Find a problem. Think about a question, frustration, or task your intended audience needs help with. 2. Use Claude or ChatGPT. Ask it to help outline a guide, organize the information, and identify gaps. Check the facts and edit the writing yourself. 3. Create the product in Canva. Turn the information into a readable ebook, checklist, planner, or template. 4. Prepare your product images. Show the cover, sample pages, and exactly what buyers receive. 5. Set up your storefront. Add a clear description, price, delivery details, and any usage terms. 6. Make promotional content. Use your AI avatar in different scenes, add a short hook, and explain the problem your product helps solve. 7. Keep learning. Ask your audience questions and improve your product based on useful feedback. One important thing: AI can help you create faster, but a product still needs accurate information and genuine value. You don't need to start with a huge course. One useful, well-made resource is enough to begin testing an idea.
